title: Interpret cosine and sine
text: The value $$\theta$$ represents a distance (or angle) along the arc length of a unit circle. The $$\cos(\theta)$$ is the $$x-$$ coordinate, and $$\sin(\theta)$$ is the $$y-$$ coordinate, of that point.

title: Determine the quadrant
text: Since the $$\cos(\theta)<0$$ and $$\sin(\theta)>0,$$ the $$x-$$ coordinate is negative and the $$y-$$ coordinate is positive. This puts $$\theta$$ in the second quadrant.\n##figure1.gif##

title: Determine range of values
text: Angles in the second quadrant must satisfy $$\frac{\pi}{2}$$ < $$\theta$$ < $$\pi$$
